modalities.evidence: HD 448-channel sEMG arrays distributed on the forearm and wrist

output.population: 21 subjects performing 20 hand gestures and 9 individual or combined finger flexions under two force levels
output.summary: High-density 448-channel surface EMG from forearm and wrist recorded together with finger joint angles and flexion forces in 21 subjects performing hand gestures and finger flexions, for motion intent recognition and prosthetic control.
